limitations: No scientific score or model/archive contents were reviewed.
No NPZ/array/model payload was opened or transferred to the local host.
measurement_scope_review: Systemd ExecMain monotonic duration, CPUUsageNSec, MemoryPeak, and configured caps are unit-property measurements.
DONE/RESULT elapsed wall and CPU values are helper-reported and are not substituted for systemd duration or CPUUsageNSec.
RESULT memory_guards are sampled cgroup-current and process-RSS observations; their sampled extrema are not systemd MemoryPeak. Process native RSS units are retained as reported.
The terminal ControlGroup was empty, so the own-unit terminal cgroup snapshot is NA; no host-root cgroup fallback was used.
model_parameters.npz evidence is limited to terminal stat size and producer-reported DONE SHA/size; the archive was not opened, copied, or independently rehashed.
The STOP_RECEIPT JSON hash and raw stop.stdout SHA are separate byte identities.
scope: Independent local review of captured receipt bindings and resource scopes; no source edits, model/archive payload reads, or scientific-score audit.
